data.loki.yaml:
apiVersion: 1
datasources:
  - name: Loki
    uid: loki
    type: loki
    access: proxy
    url: http://loki.monitoring.svc:3100
    isDefault: false
    editable: false
    jsonData:
      maxLines: 2000

command:
set -e
CFG=/host/etc/containerd/config.toml
DROPIN=/host/etc/containerd/conf.d/serverless2-registry.toml
MARK=/host/etc/containerd/certs.d/.serverless2-containerd-restarted
mkdir -p /host/etc/containerd/certs.d
# Decide on the RUNNING containerd, never on the file: a file that already carries the setting says
# nothing about whether containerd was restarted since (nodes with an appended registry
# table and no restart pulled nothing through the cache). containerd 2.x does not expose the images
# plugin's registry setting through `crictl info`, so the check is functional: pull a 2 MB image
# through the logical host exactly as the kubelet would (served by Spegel or the Zot cache).
PROBE=registry.serverless2.local/docker/library/busybox:1.36
# Memlock (docs/JOBS.md "Multi-node runs"): RDMA memory registration is bounded by RLIMIT_MEMLOCK (8 MiB on
# the node image); an unlimited limit on the containerd unit lets every container register memory without
# CAP_IPC_LOCK. The GPU cloud-init writes the same drop-in at boot; here for nodes created before it.
MEMLOCK=/host/etc/systemd/system/containerd.service.d/serverless2-memlock.conf
NEED_RESTART=0
if [ ! -f "$MEMLOCK" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$MEMLOCK")"
  printf '# serverless2 (docs/JOBS.md): RDMA pins memory; an unlimited memlock limit on the runtime lets every container\n# register memory without CAP_IPC_LOCK (the node image ships 8 MiB).\n[Service]\nLimitMEMLOCK=infinity\n' > "$MEMLOCK"
  nsenter -t 1 -m -u -i -n -p -- systemctl daemon-reload
  NEED_RESTART=1
fi
cpid=$(nsenter -t 1 -m -u -i -n -p -- pidof containerd | cut -d' ' -f1)
if [ -n "$cpid" ] && ! grep -q 'locked memory.*unlimited' "/host/proc/$cpid/limits"; then NEED_RESTART=1; fi
if [ "$NEED_RESTART" = 0 ] && chroot /host crictl pull "$PROBE" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  [ -f "$MARK" ] || touch "$MARK"; echo "containerd serves the registry mirrors (probe pull ok) with unlimited memlock"; exit 0
fi
# Legacy repair: an earlier version appended the two tables to config.toml itself, which duplicates
# the cri.containerd table and makes the next containerd start fail. Drop that trailing block.
if [ "$(grep -c '^\[plugins."io.containerd.grpc.v1.cri".containerd\]$' "$CFG")" -gt 1 ]; then
  cp "$CFG" "$CFG.serverless2-backup"
  awk -v start="$(grep -n '^\[plugins."io.containerd.grpc.v1.cri".registry\]$' "$CFG" | tail -1 | cut -d: -f1)" 'NR < start' "$CFG" > "$CFG.new" && mv "$CFG.new" "$CFG"
  echo "removed the appended registry block from config.toml (backup: config.toml.serverless2-backup)"
fi
# a drop-in, never an edit of config.toml: its tables (cri.containerd) already exist there and TOML
# forbids defining a table twice. The imports line must precede the first table: after `version`.
mkdir -p /host/etc/containerd/conf.d
grep -q '^imports' "$CFG" || sed -i '1a imports = ["/etc/containerd/conf.d/*.toml"]' "$CFG"
printf '# serverless2 image cache (docs/IMAGES.md): per-registry mirror configuration (Spegel peers, Zot cache)\nversion = 2\n[plugins."io.containerd.grpc.v1.cri".registry]\n  config_path = "/etc/containerd/certs.d"\n[plugins."io.containerd.grpc.v1.cri".containerd]\n  discard_unpacked_layers = false\n' > "$DROPIN"
chroot /host containerd -c /etc/containerd/config.toml config dump > /dev/null   # parse check before a restart
nsenter -t 1 -m -u -i -n -p -- systemctl restart containerd && touch "$MARK" && echo "containerd restarted with the registry configuration"
sleep 5; chroot /host crictl pull "$PROBE" > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo "verified: probe pull through the mirrors ok" || echo "configured; probe pull through $PROBE not yet possible (the cache or Spegel is not up yet: the next rollout re-checks)"
cpid=$(nsenter -t 1 -m -u -i -n -p -- pidof containerd | cut -d' ' -f1); grep -q 'locked memory.*unlimited' "/host/proc/$cpid/limits" && echo "verified: containerd memlock unlimited" || echo "!! containerd memlock limit still bounded (drop-in $MEMLOCK not applied?)"
initContainers.name: configure

args:
set -e
aws s3 cp /out/ "s3://${BUCKET}/cost-reports/${CLUSTER}/" --recursive --no-progress
aws s3 ls "s3://${BUCKET}/cost-reports/${CLUSTER}/" | tail -n 4
containers.name: upload

args:
set -e
d=$(date -u -d @$(( $(date -u +%s) - 86400 )) +%F 2>/dev/null || date -u +%F)
for agg in namespace node; do
  curl -sf "http://opencost.opencost.svc:9003/allocation/compute?window=yesterday&aggregate=$agg&accumulate=true" -o /out/$d-$agg.json
  echo "fetched $agg: $(wc -c < /out/$d-$agg.json) bytes"
done
initContainers.name: fetch

spec.description: tenant pods without an execution profile may reach the world, never the instance metadata service
tenant namespaces talk to themselves, DNS, the API server, endpoints and the world only

object.description: Backfill / bulk runs; last in the queue, first to be evicted by customer-batch.
Customer-facing run-class work; ordered first and may evict bulk-backfill within the queue.

annotations.description: Kueue admitted the workload but no node has a free GPU: the pool is at its maximum (fleet.yaml max_nodes), an endpoint holds the last GPU, or spot capacity is unavailable (recover-stopped-nodes logs in ops).
annotations.summary: Admitted run pods pending >10 min in {{ $labels.namespace }}

annotations.description: ClusterQueue quota exhausted (nominalQuota = pool max minus warm endpoints). Raise max_nodes + quota or wait for running work to finish.
annotations.summary: Workloads waiting for quota in {{ $labels.cluster_queue }} for 15 min

rules.expr:
sum by (namespace, pod, node, pool) (
  (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="nvidia_com_gpu"}
    * on (namespace, pod) group_left() (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running"} == 1))
  * on (node) group_left(pool) serverless2:node_pool:info)

sum by (namespace, inferenceservice, pool) (
  serverless2:pod_gpu_requests:running
  * on (namespace, pod) group_left(inferenceservice)
    label_replace(kube_pod_labels{label_serving_kserve_io_inferenceservice!=""},
      "inferenceservice", "$1", "label_serving_kserve_io_inferenceservice", "(.*)"))

count by (namespace) (
  kube_pod_status_unschedulable == 1
  and on (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="nvidia_com_gpu"} > 0))

count by (namespace) (
  kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Pending"} == 1
  and on (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="nvidia_com_gpu"} > 0))

annotations.description: No GPU node could take the pod for 5 minutes (pool at max, spot capacity gone, or a wrong toleration/nodeSelector). Kueue-gated pods do not trigger this.
Quota is exhausted or the cohort cannot lend. Check kueue_cluster_queue_status and the GPU pool size.
annotations.summary: ClusterQueue {{ $labels.cluster_queue }} has {{ $value }} pending workload(s) for 15 min

annotations.description: Spot nodes stopped by preemption keep their Node object for a while; the pod will be rescheduled by the Job controller/Knative, but the pool counts the node as used.
Ready=False for 10 minutes (image pull, model download, GPU wait or a crashing predictor). Scaled-to-zero endpoints stay Ready and do not trigger this.
Self-signed certificates are issued for 1 year and renewed by cert-manager 2/3 into their lifetime; this fires only if renewal is stuck.

annotations.summary: No DCGM metrics from GPU node {{ $labels.node }} (pool {{ $labels.pool }})

annotations.description: Measured at the Envoy gateway in front of the customer API (route api/api). Check the api pods, LiteLLM (key validation) and the regional kubeconfigs.
annotations.summary: API 5xx ratio {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} for 5 min (gateway route api)

annotations.description: Prometheus (retention 30d / 45GB) or Loki (retention 30d) storage above 80 percent: lower the retention or grow the volume.
annotations.summary: Volume {{ $labels.persistentvolumeclaim }} in monitoring is {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} full

annotations.description: A receiver is failing for an hour (the in-cluster sink, or an external receiver added later). Check `kubectl -n monitoring logs alertmanager-kube-prometheus-stack-alertmanager-0 -c alertmanager`.
annotations.summary: Alertmanager cannot deliver through the {{ $labels.integration }} integration

gateway.external-gateways:
- class: eg
  gateway: envoy-gateway-system/serverless2-external
  service: envoy-gateway-system/knative-external
  supported-features:
    - HTTPRouteRequestTimeout
gateway.local-gateways:
- class: eg
  gateway: envoy-gateway-system/serverless2-internal
  service: envoy-gateway-system/knative-internal
  supported-features:
    - HTTPRouteRequestTimeout

object.description: Default for run-class pods (set by the API on every run pod). Never preempts; first victim of serverless2-interactive.
Priority run class (customer-batch). Never preempts; only ordered ahead of serverless2-batch.
Interactive endpoints (KServe/Knative). Preempts run-class pods on a full GPU pool.
